entry.title: All-Atom Equivariant Flow Matching for De Novo Metalloenzyme Active-Site Design
entry.summary:
Existing protein structure diffusion models struggle with transition-metal coordination geometry where $3d$-orbital electronic effects govern catalytic turnover. We couple $SE(3)$-equivariant flow matching with a tight-binding quantum mechanical potential, designing zinc and iron hydrolases that achieve $k_{\text{cat}}/K_M > 10^5\text{ M}^{-1}\text{s}^{-1}$ in wet-lab assays without directed evolution.

Source: arXiv Quantitative Biology (q-bio.BM) · Tags: #genomics-proteins #bioinformatics

entry.title: Pangenome Graph Indexing in Sub-Linear Space via Wheeler Bureaucrat Wavelet Trees
entry.summary:
Population-scale human pangenome graphs containing thousands of haplotypes exceed $100\text{ GB}$ of RAM using conventional $k$-mer seed tables. We construct a compressed Wheeler graph index over bidirectional FM-indexes that aligns long Nanopore reads in $4.2\text{ GB}$ of memory at $3.4\times$ higher throughput than Minigraph-Cactus.

Source: Nature Computational Science · Tags: #bioinformatics #genomics-proteins #algorithms

entry.title: Neural Phonon Boltzmann Transport Solver Identifies Ultralow-Kappa Solid-State Electrolytes
entry.summary:
First-principles anharmonic lattice dynamics ($3$- and $4$-phonon scattering) scales as $O(N_{\text{atoms}}^4)$, preventing high-throughput screening of solid-state lithium electrolytes. Our equivariant phonon neural operator predicts full thermal conductivity tensors within $4\%$ of DFT-BTE at $10^4\times$ lower compute cost, uncovering three stable argyrodite phases.

Source: arXiv Materials & CompSci (cond-mat.mtrl-sci) · Tags: #materials-science #clean-tech
